title: His uncle Louis Arthidore and his father in the Onward Brass Band
summary: His uncle was a fine clarinetist; his father played cornet then alto in the same brass band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, my uncle, my mother's brother, he was one of the finest clarinetists we had here in New Orleans, I understand. What I was told from a lot of old time musicians, his name was Louis Arthedale, and he played with the Armored Brass Band, it was many, many years ago. My father happened to be in that band at the time, and my father played the Conet at that time, an Armored Band. They played the Ford and Moist Parade, they played the Fireman's Parade, all big parades, played with a lot of bands. Who was Lincoln in New Orleans? Who was Lincoln in New Orleans? Before my time, I couldn't tell you who was Lincoln Brass Band, no.

It wasn't Manuel Perez in those days, somebody before then? No, no, before Manuel Perez's time, I wanted to know. That's what I wanted to make sure. He played the Coronet at first, then what did he play?
He went to the Alto, which is called the Melo Fornidale, I mean.
Your father's name is? Is it John Barberang. How many brothers do you have?
